sources.title: BloodMNIST: Biomedical Imaging Benchmark
sources.snippet: BloodMNIST is a biomedical imaging benchmark comprising 17,092 blood cell images across 8 classes, typically resized to 28x28 pixels. It supports centralized, federated, and split learning protocols, with studies exploring different resolutions, normalization, and augmentation strategies. Key research themes include quantum-enhanced models, open-set recognition, and machine unlearning ...
